$comment: Hand-written prose injected into the generated tokens/globals.css. Figma owns VALUES; this file owns EXPLANATION. Edit this, never globals.css — the generator overwrites globals.css on every run but reads this file verbatim. Keys that no longer match a token are reported by export-tokens.mjs as stale rather than silently dropped.

pairingRules: label-md + body-sm      dense UI (menus, rows, tables) — the default pair
Do not mix densities inside one surface: a 14px label above a 13px body
reads as a mistake, not a hierarchy.
halfStepRamp: Formerly labelled "exception tokens pending reconciliation". Resolved
9 Aug 2026: they are PROMOTED to first-class ramp members. Do not delete.
A binding census over all 58 pages found 4,814 live bindings across 24 of
these 26 tokens. The two largest are not strays — they are the spine of the
type system: size/13 (1,345 bindings) and line-height/18 (1,359) together
are 13/18, which is Label/MD ("THE default UI label") and Body/SM ("THE
default UI body"). Snapping them to the coarse ramp would have shifted the
most-used type in the library. The ramp was incomplete; these values were
size/20 and line-height/12 carried zero bindings and were deleted 9 Aug 2026.
